The '''gillom''' was a type of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] found on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> A bird of prey, the gillom's [[Diet/Legends|diet]] primarily consisted of [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|males]] sometimes had "Gillom" as their given name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gillom was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
